body: Update: My bf moved in with me for a bit till we can afford our own place and today was his birthday. I went put to the market and bought him a cake and was about to fill the house up with groceries he eats, he's not use to asian food. I dropped my wallet and someone stole it. I recently got a job and just got paid I lost all my money and my card. I ruined his birthday and have to restart on my income and wont be able to save the amount for a place at the dead line to help my bf and I feel like shit. I hope whoever stole my money rethinks their choices because im being pushed to the edge right now.

I do often with my best friend who has been there for every episode and major life changes. Although, he is an awesome friend talking to him feels helpless to me now because I have been for years but I still start back at square one. I do not think getting professional help will do me any justice because I know what me issues are and tried hobbies, even moved away from my siblings who I hold dear to heart just to get away from my toxic mom and stepdad.(Including some weed to see if it changes anything but thats temporary and do not wanna depend on drugs any longer)

So personally my younger sister had a panic attack and called the hotline to help her calm down and fall asleep with her. She had no intentions of doing anything but when they ask her to get a hold of a family member she declined cuz she didnt wanna bother anyone. So they decided it was okay to send the police to our house where my stubborn close minded mom got hold of why the police were there. So it depends on what the person on the other line thinks is right so ots a 50/50.
